name: Oliver Schmid
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: Ollie Schmid (4-3, age 26; City Kickboxing; a New Zealander, per LowKick) is an aggressive young featherweight who took his UFC debut on three days' notice in May and was knocked out by Marwan Rahiki in R1. This is his first UFC fight with a full camp. His record is thin and mostly from Australian and New Zealand regional shows.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive starter: opened with kicks against Rahiki, surged forward with a flurry, and found some success with straight punches before being dropped by a left hand (Cageside Press). Three R1 KO/TKO regional wins, including a 15-second finish of Jeff Mesa in March.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Little evidence either way. Was submitted in R3 of his 2023 pro debut.
how_they_fight.Defense: The chin and defensive responsibility in exchanges are the concern: stopped by strikes in his last two losses (Dimps Gillies, R3 TKO in 2024; Rahiki, R1 KO in 2026). Got trapped against the fence by Rahiki before the finish.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Wins early, loses late or to power. All three stoppage wins came in R1; his one decision win went 15 minutes. Two of his three losses came in R3 (submission 2023, TKO 2024). A fast starter whose tank and durability later in fights are the question.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Brave and willing (took the UFC fight on three days' notice while preparing for a regional bout), but still very inexperienced: seven pro fights since 2023.

patterns: Two of three losses came in R3; the other was an R1 KO by a heavy hitter
concerns: Durability: stopped by strikes in his last two losses
Late-fight cardio and grappling unknown at this level
keys_to_beat: Weather his early aggression, then counter as he presses
Make it a long fight; he has lost twice in R3

news.text: Replaced the injured Jack Jenkins against Marwan Rahiki at UFC Perth on three days' notice.
Knocked out by Rahiki at 2:47 of R1.
Cageside noted he had been preparing for a HEX Fight Series bout when the UFC called.
